I wasn't able to write these notes. I hit the tool limit for this session before I read a single page.

**What happened:** I tried to fetch six pages at once: Enduring Word on Psalm 49, Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub, the NET Bible notes, and Precept Austin. A coding error in how I handled the results meant I never saw any content. When I tried again, my web access was used up for this turn.

**Why I've stopped there:** you asked me to report only what the pages say and to give a URL for every point. Anything I wrote now would come from my own memory, not from those sources, so I've left the notes out.

**To continue:** ask again in a new message and I'll start over. I'll go verse by verse through Enduring Word, Gill, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and Precept Austin. Then I'll look for:
- **Where Protestant traditions differ:** mainly v. 15, where I'll check whether Wesley, Spurgeon and others read it as hope of resurrection or rescue from early death.
- **Other views:** the NET Bible notes on the hard Hebrew in vv. 11 and 14, plus any Catholic and Orthodox readings.
- **Popular modern teaching:** anything the sites say about prosperity teaching and wealth.
